title: David B. Haight
vital_facts: Baptized as a child; Aaronic Priesthood as a youth; Melchizedek Priesthood as a young man
World War II veteran; Corporate executive
Counselor in Bishopric, Alternate High Councilor, Stake President
Served as Mayor of Palo Alto, California before leaving in 1963 to preside over the Scottish Mission
Ordained Apostle and sustained to Twelve 1976-2004
